evidence.t: About 18 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.
Beside Framstead Creek: backwater or oxbow (estimate).

seasonRows.notes: District 7. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 99 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 54.3546, -120.80803, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 6.6 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 232 m, about 156 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 40 m SW of the spot at 1,074 m (54.41239, -120.83153). Water: unnamed wetland 30 m N (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-18, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BA-duck-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-18: about 1,882 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.48 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
